data.one_liner: A widget wrapper that overlays loading animations on top of Flutter content.
data.what_it_does: It wraps any Flutter widget in a loading overlay that can display a progress indicator along with optional header and footer widgets when loading is active. It includes several built-in loading animations and customizable properties like background colors.
use_when: You need to block user interaction and show a loading spinner during an asynchronous operation.
You want a simple widget wrapper that handles conditional loading states over existing layouts.
avoid_when: You require complex state management solutions to handle the underlying data loading.
You only need full-page route transitions rather than an overlay wrapper.
strengths: Provides multiple built-in loading animations and customizations.
Supports custom header and bottom text or widgets during loading.
weaknesses: Limited to the specific animations provided by the underlying package set.
Requires using older flutter versions specifically for the example files according to the docs.
data.minimal_example:
LoadingOverlayPro(
  isLoading: true,
  child: Container(),
  progressIndicator: LoadingBouncingLine.circle(),
)
